When you expand an image link inline you can resize it by clicking and dragging, however the image can change color due to the image becoming selected. You have to click off it to deselect it.

Bug reported here: https://voat.co/v/voatdev/1683584

Voat devs will probably get around to fixing it soon enough, until then here is a user script Greasemonkey / Tappermonkey which prevents highlighting of the expando so it doesn't change color when resizing:

// ==UserScript==
// @name Expando Unselect
// @namespace voat.co/u/vortexcortex
// @description Fix expando resize selection bug.
// @include https://voat.co/*
// @version 3
// @grant none
// ==/UserScript==

(new function(){

function prevDef( event ){ event.preventDefault() };
 
function fixExpandos(){
 var expandos = $('div[class*="expando"]');
 
 // HAX: Look up JQuery fn maps, less time to just write this out.
 for ( var fix = expandos.length; --fix >= 0; ){
 var exp = expandos[fix];
 if (!exp.vc_expandoUnselect ){
 exp.addEventListener( "mouseup", prevDef, false );
 exp.addEventListener( "mousedown", prevDef, false );
 exp.addEventListener( "mousemove", prevDef, false );
 exp.vc_expandoUnselect = true;
 }
 } 
}

$(document).ready( fixExpandos );

// HAX: Should call fixExpandos() on inline expando onclick instead.
setInterval( fixExpandos, 808 );

})();
Temp Fix for Resizing Images on Drag: Prevent Highlighting / Color change during drag.
